articles.title: Tesla’s Problem Is Opposite of Big Tech: Not Enough AI Spending
articles.summary: After hearing Tesla Inc.’s seemingly countless promises about artificial intelligence, autonomous driving and robotics, Wall Street wants the company to start putting its money where its mouth is.

articles.title: OpenAI’s Agents Reach 10 Million Users After ChatGPT Work Debut
articles.summary: OpenAI has seen a sharp uptick in demand for its artificial intelligence agents since its recent release of ChatGPT Work, providing new momentum in its bid to keep pace with rival Anthropic PBC.

articles.title: OpenAI Names BNY, Nubank CEOs to Board Ahead of IPO
articles.summary: OpenAI has appointed two financial services executives to its board of directors, drawing on their experience as the company moves toward a Wall Street debut.

articles.title: Google Expands in Miami After Its Billionaire Founders Buy Homes
articles.summary: Alphabet Inc., has more than quadrupled its office space in Miami this year shortly after co-founders Larry Page and Sergey Brin bought homes in the area.

articles.title: OpenAI Says Its AI Caused Hugging Face Cyber Breach
articles.summary: OpenAI said its artificial intelligence models were able to compromise the internal systems of startup Hugging Face Inc., offering an early glimpse of how AI systems could fuel new cybersecurity threats.

articles.title: Amazon’s Portal for Business Nears $60 Billion in Revenue
articles.summary: Amazon.com Inc.’s business sales unit was recently on track to sell $60 billion of merchandise over the course of a full year, up about 71% from 2023, evidence that the world’s largest online retailer is gaining ground in corporate sales.

articles.title: Nvidia Touts Progress Getting New Rubin Design to Customers
articles.summary: Nvidia Corp., the semiconductor company at the heart of the artificial intelligence boom, said its latest chip designs are making their way to customers and will help solidify the chipmaker’s leadership in the industry.

articles.title: OpenAI’s Altman to Brief US Officials on Next Wave of AI Models
articles.summary: OpenAI Chief Executive Officer Sam Altman plans to brief the Trump administration and US lawmakers next week on the upcoming generation of artificial intelligence models as the US works to create a process to review the safety of cutting-edge AI systems, according to a senior company executive.

articles.title: China’s Kimi K3 fuels fears safety curbs are holding back US AI
articles.summary: Chinese unicorn Moonshot AI’s new Kimi K3 model rivals top US systems in spotting cybersecurity flaws, according to early research, stoking fears in Washington that strict safety guard rails are putting American artificial intelligence firms at a competitive disadvantage. articles.title: Robinhood Prediction Market Revenue to Top Crypto: Analysts
articles.summary: Trading platform Robinhood Markets Inc.’s revenue from prediction market is set to overshadow that from cryptocurrency trading, starting as soon as the second quarter, analysts at Bernstein and Piper Sandler said this week.

articles.title: Bitcoin Rallies After Bessent Says Clarity Act at ‘1-Yard Line’
articles.summary: Crypto markets are stirring after months of listless trading on signs that Washington is moving toward a clearer rulebook for digital assets.
